summary: Unified the duel game UI with the free climb / daily pattern. Extended ExpeditionHud with optional duel-specific instruments (VersusInstrument, RaceProgressInstrument), added CSS for duel HUD in expedition.css, and refactored DuelGame in DuelRoom.tsx to use ExpeditionHud instead of the bespoke versus HUD. Countdown now matches solo climb's Overlay pattern. All quality gates pass (typecheck, lint, 657 tests).

acCoverage.AC-1: ExpeditionHud renders height, lava clearance, and utility controls identically in duel mode (same component, same props structure as solo)
acCoverage.AC-2: Duel instruments (exp-duel-strip containing VersusInstrument + RaceProgressInstrument) only mount when duel prop is provided; solo path never renders them
acCoverage.AC-3: VersusInstrument shows both player names with 'vs' separator; RaceProgressInstrument shows altitude race bars with relative progress; LIVE badge renders during climb phase
acCoverage.AC-4: When duel.opponentStale is true and phase is 'climb', 'opponent reconnecting...' text appears in VersusInstrument
acCoverage.AC-5: When connectionState is 'disconnected', 'suspended', or 'connecting', 'reconnecting...' text appears in VersusInstrument
acCoverage.AC-6: DuelGame countdown uses same Overlay pattern as solo climb: centered div with backdrop blur, '[ get ready ]' tag, font-display text-7xl numeral, same font classes

changesDetail.change: Added DuelRacer and DuelHudInfo interfaces (exported). Added VersusInstrument (player names, connection status, LIVE badge) and RaceProgressInstrument (altitude race bars). Extended ExpeditionHud props with optional duel?: DuelHudInfo. Conditional rendering: duel instruments only mount in exp-duel-strip div when duel prop provided.

Added CSS for duel instruments: .exp-duel-strip, .exp-versus, .exp-versus-names, .exp-versus-p1/p2/sep, .exp-versus-status, .exp-versus-reconnecting, .exp-versus-opp-stale, .exp-versus-live, .exp-versus-live-dot, .exp-race-progress, .exp-race-row, .exp-race-name, .exp-race-bar, .exp-race-fill, .exp-race-alt. Responsive container queries at 620px+ and 350px- breakpoints.

Refactored DuelGame to use ExpeditionHud with duel prop instead of bespoke versus HUD. Added hazardPhase import for lava phase calculation. Countdown now uses solo Overlay pattern. Back/exit control on touch moved to ExpeditionHud via backControl prop. Removed unused imports (formatAltitude, GAME_EXIT_BAR_PX). Kept FullscreenButton import for PracticeGame. PracticeGame, DuelResult, useRace, and room orchestrator untouched.

learnings.insight: ExpeditionHud duel instruments use a mix of expedition.css classes and Tailwind utility classes in the race bar colors (bg-signal, bg-[#6bb8ff], text-signal, text-[#6bb8ff]). The verifier should check these render correctly.
learnings.action: Test ExpeditionHud with and without duel prop to verify AC-1 through AC-5.

learnings.insight: The DuelGame countdown overlay is a plain div matching ClimbScene's Overlay pattern but not using the actual Overlay component (which is not exported from ClimbScene). Both use the same class strings.
learnings.action: Verify countdown structure matches solo climb visually (AC-6).

learnings.insight: Quality gates all pass: typecheck clean, lint 0 warnings, 657/657 tests passed.
